clue.text: Support US athlete's role-reversal

parts.note: a jock is American slang for a sporty type, with the 's giving the S

indicators.note: reversal says the word for role is read backwards

parts.note: a part is a role played by an actor

explanation.surface: An American sportsman is suddenly cast in the opposite role to the one he usually plays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'role-reversal' reads as one idea, but it splits in two: 'role' is the word and 'reversal' turns it round, giving TRAP.
explanation.definitionFit: This garment is a protective athletic undergarment, a kind of support worn by sportsmen.

clue.text: Solemn people under Japan's leader showing signs of ageing?

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sitting under another means it comes after it
a leader comes at the front, so the opening letter of the word for Japan is taken

parts.note: owls are proverbially solemn-looking, so solemn people can be called owls

explanation.surface: Grave-faced folk serve under the Japanese premier, looking their age.
explanation.definitionFit: Sagging flesh at the jaw and cheeks is a familiar visible mark of growing older, hence the question mark for an example.

clue.text: Picture of empty box?

indicators.note: read as 'box of empty', the box holds the emptiness, so the empty letter goes inside

parts.note: a carton is a cardboard box
O, the figure zero, looks like an empty ring and stands for nothing

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a photograph of a box with nothing in it.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'empty box' as a box of nothing: O inside CARTON.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic drawing or animated film is a kind of picture.

clue.text: Planned school for publicity in patient preparation?

indicators.note: school for publicity means the letters for school stand in place of those for publicity

parts.note: a premed is the sedative given to a patient before surgery
PR is public relations, i.e. publicity

explanation.surface: A school is promoted inside a hospital's pre-operation routine.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap PR out of PREMED and put SCH in its place.
explanation.definitionFit: To have plotted or contrived something is to have planned it, usually with a hint of cunning.

clue.text: Quickly accomplished uprising in Burundi Parliament

indicators.note: uprising says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A revolt in an African country's legislature is over in no time.
explanation.walkthrough: No word signals the hiding: DIPAR sits across 'Burundi Parliament', and 'uprising' (going up a down light) turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Something swift or fast-paced is done quickly, the plain sense of the adjective.

clue.text: Turn sanctimonious lecturer out of game of chance

parts.note: pi is informal for pious or sanctimonious

indicators.note: out of says one letter is taken away from the game

parts.note: roulette is a casino game of chance

explanation.surface: A preachy academic is thrown out of a casino game.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballet spin on one foot is a turn of the body.

clue.text: Hat deprived fellow dropped

indicators.note: dropped says a letter is taken out

parts.note: bereft means deprived of something

explanation.surface: A poor man who has lost his headgear.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft round flat cap is a type of hat.

clue.text: Hold up a type of chisel

definitions.meaning: to prop up or support something
a broad-bladed chisel used by bricklayers

explanation.surface: A tool that keeps things standing.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: reinforce or support, and a mason's wide-bladed cutting tool.

clue.text: Russian imperial family wander endlessly around country

indicators.note: around says the cut-down word goes outside the country
endlessly says the word loses its final letter

parts.note: to rove is to wander
Oman is a country in Arabia

explanation.surface: The Tsar's dynasty roams without end across their land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' leaves ROV, and 'around' wraps it about the Gulf state.
explanation.definitionFit: The ruling dynasty of the tsars from 1613 until 1917 bore this surname.

clue.text: Records about officer and soldiers source of stomach upset?

indicators.note: about says the recordings surround the other letters

parts.note: tapes are recordings
WO is Warrant Officer
RM is the Royal Marines, soldiers serving with the navy

explanation.surface: Military files describe an officer and troops with an upset stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: Intestinal parasites can cause gut trouble, an example the question mark admits.

clue.text: Party official entertains Arab head of state in frigate?

indicators.note: entertains says the official holds the other letters inside

parts.note: a whip is the party official who enforces discipline in Parliament
AR is an abbreviation for Arab or Arabic

indicators.note: head of picks out the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A party manager hosts an Arab ruler aboard a navy vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A frigate is one example of a fighting ship, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Cleaner's on list to get food

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece on another means it follows it

parts.note: a roll is a list of names
a mop is a cleaner, the 's standing for is

explanation.surface: A cleaner is on a rota so as to earn a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A rolled pickled herring fillet is an item of food.

clue.text: Attacked and kept blockading Malta

indicators.note: blockading says the word for kept surrounds the island's letter

parts.note: stored means kept
M is the international vehicle code for Malta

explanation.surface: A navy assaulted the island and maintained a siege.
explanation.definitionFit: Charged and took by force, as troops do to a position: a synonym.

clue.text: Like Billy Joel's girl and Oscar moving west to date

indicators.note: moving says one letter shifts to a new place

parts.note: Billy Joel sang of an Uptown Girl
Oscar is O in the radio alphabet

explanation.surface: A pop song's heroine and an Academy Award are heading west.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' acts on 'west': the W in UPTOWNO shifts to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto, until the present moment: a phrase meaning the same as so far.

clue.text: Row before transatlantic call to Joe and Bill

indicators.note: before places the row first

parts.note: a bank is a row, as of keys or oars
in the US, the draft is conscription, the call-up of GI Joe

explanation.surface: An argument precedes an American phone call to two men named Joe and Bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' suggests a quarrel but is a line; 'Joe' is the ordinary American soldier, not a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: An order on a bank to pay is a bill of exchange.

clue.text: Glass that shows sign of change under pressure?

definitions.text: Glass that shows sign of change under pressure?

parts.words: Glass that shows sign of change under pressure?
parts.note: a weather glass shows a change of atmospheric pressure, the surface suggesting stressed glass cracking

explanation.surface: A pane that cracks when stressed.
explanation.definitionFit: A weather glass measures air pressure, whose shifts signal changing weather.

clue.text: Key specialist in design work?

parts.note: the person who designs buildings; 'key' hints at a keystone and also means leading

explanation.surface: A locksmith working on design.
explanation.definitionFit: A designer of buildings is the main expert in that design, including its arches and keystones.

clue.text: Get better after leaving city with traveller

indicators.note: after leaving says letters are dropped from the word

parts.note: to recover is to get better
EC is the postcode for the City of London

explanation.surface: A patient recovers once out of town with a wanderer.
explanation.definitionFit: A wanderer or nomad is a traveller.

clue.text: Timeless figures of speech. They are known by an adept

definitions.text: They are known by an adept

indicators.note: timeless says the letter for time is dropped

parts.note: tropes are figures of speech

explanation.surface: Ageless metaphors are familiar to an expert.
explanation.definitionFit: An expert is said to know the procedures, from the idiom 'know the ropes'.

clue.text: Old recipe kitchen police included in mess food

indicators.note: included in says the letters go inside the word for mess

parts.note: pie is printers' jumbled type, a mess
R stands for recipe, from Latin recipe on prescriptions
KP is US army kitchen police duty

explanation.surface: An old recipe from army cooks ends up in mess hall grub.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastry-encased savoury meat dish is a kind of food.

clue.text: Ghosts' morale

definitions.meaning: a person's mood, as in high or low

explanation.surface: The mood among phantoms.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both supernatural beings and a person's state of mind.

clue.text: Dreary US TV series about the French

indicators.note: about says the series' letters surround the article

parts.note: Cheers was an American sitcom set in a Boston bar
les is French for 'the' plural

explanation.surface: An American sitcom about France is dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Gloomy and joyless: a synonym for dreary.

clue.text: Withdraw to learn a new skill after leaving Indiana for Connecticut

indicators.note: leaving says the state's letters go out
for says the second state's letters replace them

parts.note: to retrain is to learn a new skill
IN is the postal code for Indiana
CT is the postal code for Connecticut

explanation.surface: A worker moves state to retrain.
explanation.definitionFit: To take back a statement or pull in claws is to withdraw it.

clue.text: I have support for on-line test that is controversial

indicators.note: in a down clue, the second piece holds up the first from below

parts.note: e- prefix means online, and the MOT is the annual British vehicle test
I've contracts I have

explanation.surface: Someone backs an internet exam that has stirred dispute.
explanation.walkthrough: MOT is the yearly UK roadworthiness test; E- means on the internet.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic arousing strong feelings stirs controversy.

clue.text: Maybe it's found in museum art in Italy

definitions.note: 'it' is Italian vermouth, as in gin and it; this is a brand of it

indicators.note: found in says the answer lies within the following words

explanation.surface: Perhaps a masterpiece turns up in an Italian gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' looks like a pronoun but is short for Italian vermouth, and this is an example brand.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-known brand of Italian vermouth, called 'it' in the phrase gin and it.

clue.text: Explore with sexy eastern European after exchanging introductions

indicators.note: the first letters of the two words swap places

parts.note: hot means sexy
a Pole is from Poland

explanation.surface: A flirtation with an attractive Pole after the formal introductions.
explanation.definitionFit: To go caving is to explore underground systems, the verb sense.

clue.text: Smooth tree's surface

definitions.meaning: the London tree with peeling bark

explanation.surface: Sanding down the bark of a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Three senses: a carpenter's smoothing tool's action, a broad-leaved tree, and a flat expanse.

clue.text: Party's one result

explanation.surface: A political party gets one outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a social occasion and an outcome.

clue.text: Joint operations in progress

indicators.note: in says the operations go inside the word for progress

parts.note: tide is a course or flow onward
ops is short for operations

explanation.surface: Joint military operations are under way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Joint' means a cut of beef here, not a combined effort.
explanation.definitionFit: A lean cut of beef from the upper thigh is a joint for roasting.

clue.text: A sin eating all rations primarily

definitions.text: A sin eating all rations primarily

indicators.note: eating says the sin swallows the other letters

parts.note: a vice is a sin

indicators.note: primarily picks out the first letters of the two words

explanation.surface: Greed is a deadly sin consuming all the food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eating' signals the container; read whole, the clue also describes greed itself, so it is an &lit.
explanation.definitionFit: Greed for wealth is one of the seven deadly sins, and it grabs everything.

clue.text: Banks return payment in Rupees

indicators.note: in says the payment goes inside the currency letters
return says the payment is read backwards

parts.note: a fee is a payment

explanation.surface: Banks hand back a fee in Indian money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Banks' is not finance: it means ridges of rock or sand under the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Submerged ridges of rock or coral are underwater banks.

clue.text: Jolly Jacks' time in care?

parts.note: a jolly is an outing or treat
jacks are ordinary men

explanation.surface: Sailors on a spree spend time in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Medical attention given to a patient is a form of care.
